- The man was not given a chance to prove his innocence
- The description "one-sided" is provided, which likely refers to the nature of the proceeding

This is clearly describing a miscarriage of justice. The key principles here are:
1. Due process - fundamental right to a fair trial
2. Presumption of innocence - cornerstone of modern legal systems
3. Right to defense - ability to present evidence and prove innocence
